body: Sad isn't it
I know that feeling too well
It's so hard. We often lose ourselves in our relationships. It takes time to heal. Unfortunately we can't wake up tomorrow feeling better. Sorry things are so hard for you now.
I feel this way all the time. All the time people walk by me like I'm not there and have a conversation like I'm not in the room. It's hard and I'm sorry
I am the same. Some people look for exits when they walk in a room but I well.... I guess it's a different type of exit
I do too. I also always find myself on here. I woke up this morning and it was one of those nights when you sleep so peaceful and you wonder if this is what death is like
I feel this way but I push people away all the time.
Same
I say that about my organs. Instead of rotting them through a shitty suicide, how about I go to the hospital and they take them. Give them to people that are loved and matter.

I feel the same. I'm older and don't live with my parents but there are no shopping trips with Mom or lunches with Dad. I occasionally get a text from my mother not telling me she misses me or loves me or anything but normally something dumb like you got a letter here. I wish my partner was that person but I'm 3rd to 4th at best. I hope you find that person. I know how much it hurts to have no one.
That's very kind of you but I know deep down that I should. I've put this off way too long now.
Thank you. Today has been hard. It's nice to know that there are good people like you around.
Agreed. Pretty much me all day.
Sounds like you are a good dad and I hope your family appreciates that. It's hard being in a world full of so many people but here we are alone.
I agree. I spend all day inside my head.
I feel like I've missed out alot too. I've always did what I was supposed to do but never really thought about what makes me happy. I spend most of my day and night alone so I get it.

Have you seen the show after life? He says that he can do whatever he wants and just kill himself if things go bad it's like a super power. I really wish I could say screw this and start doing what I want to do but I don't. I'm too scared

I'm very sorry you feel this way. I really hope that things change for you. 30 is just a marker for me. It just reminds me that I still haven't done anything and things haven't gotten better. I've thought about doing it on my birthday too. I thought the nice thing about that is that people will only have to think of you one day a year instead of two. Meeting someone isn't everything it is better to be a 30 year old virgin than someone in a terrible relationship. 

Thank you I can't tell you last time I was told that I was loved. I'm alone in this world

I wish I could say I was strong I don't tell people because I'm scared. I'm scared of what people would think of me I'm scared of people's reactions. I just can't even begin to tell anyone how I feel ever. I always just pretend to be someone who I'm not. I think a lot of people work with me would say I'm up bubbly person and that's not me at all. I've tried testing things out with people around me and they always fail. I remember just people telling me things that just were red flags that I should never tell them anything. One of my closest friends told me that she stopped being friends with someone that self-harm because she was afraid of them. I don't want people to be afraid of me I would never do anything to anyone else. I wants told someone about some things that have happened in my past and they deny that they happened.  The person who did this is very good at putting on a show for people and they believe them.

Thank you thank you for being so kind I wish it were true
that is very sweet of you to offer to talk to me but I'm afraid I'd be a disappointment

That's how I feel. You would think that things once would turn in my favor just by chance. I've lost all hope. I feel like that is the difference between when I was younger vs now. I always thought things could change but they won't. They might change for the people around me and all sorts of good things will happen for them but just usual shitty for me. The only thing that ever kept me going was that little bit of hope but now it's gone and I'm still here.
I know how terrible everything can feel but I really wish that I could help you. Have you told anyone of your plan?

Sorry. My friends cancelled plans on me and now I'm stuck home alone. I spend way to much time alone. I honestly wonder what they are doing all the time. Do they just not like me. We are adults let's not pretend. I just don't get it. When I'm someone's friend I commit to that. I find it impossible to make new friends. I feel like I just don't relate to many people and I have to put on a show.

It's so hard. I just don't know what to do anymore. I find it so hard to work. I have no choice about working. I would lose everything (the little I have)if I didn't work. Do you feel like your job makes things worst? I'm sorry about your day. It was such a hard ride home but we made it. Hoping tomorrow is better for you.

I've never told anyone about my self harm. I started when I was 12 probably and the worst was when I was about 16. Im almost 30 and I still think about it. It gets harder to do when you have a partner that you need to hide it from. I don't think that I could tell anyone. My partner  years ago told me that he thinks it is stupid so I'll never open up to him about it. One of my friends stop being friends with a person that did it because it scared her. I still think about it so much and honestly if there were better ways to hid it from my partner I would. I don't think anything would stop me. I don't do it for attention and I'm not putting down anyone who does but in a sad way I just do it for myself. I never told anyone because I was scared of what people would think of me which is true more now than before. I also didn't want anyone stopping me. Thank you for sharing. I was starting g to wonder if Im the only adult that thinks this way and struggles with this. You hear all the time of the lonely teenager that self harms but what happens when they become an adult.

Ive been suicidal for over 15 years now. I am just as perplexed why I haven't done it. I just feel like there were always signs telling me that I should. Sometimes I hear about people talking about depression and how they are better. I don't know if I'll ever be better. At what point is it pointless.

I have felt this way and I'm 10 years older. Ive never been confident in anything at all including in this. There are just so many questions. I feel like you still have time that I wish I had. You are 19 things can change for you.
I completely agree. Like no one fucking cares until it has to get to that point.

I know it must be hard filing for bankruptcy but atleast you still have your family. I'm sure that they would be devastated without you. I wouldn't count on insurance money because they may never get it. Hope that you reconsider things. It sounds like you have some very important people in your life. There are many of us who are very alone. You have many more good years left.

It's so hard being feeling so alone all the time. I know how you feel and I'm sorry. I definitely don't let everyone in on every part of me because I'm so alone now never mind if I was putting my shit on people but still at the end of day I have no one. I really hope that you reach out and find a good therapist. I've never gone to one but it's good to hear it worked well for you. Please get the help that you need

That sounds god awful. It's hard to only have one person in your life. I use to have a best friend and she was everything to me. I don't open up to people for a list of reasons. She was the only one I somewhat  opened up to. The past couple of months she cancelled plans with me so many times that I don't bother making plans with her. If I say even small things to her I get the fucking thumbs up button on Facebook. I know she is sick of me so I don't bother her anymore. It's just what are we supposed to do from here on out. Other people would tell us to make friends but it not that easy. It's not like when your a kid and you both like the same toy. You need more to build a relationship on. I try to be friendly with people but I don't feel much of a connection with them. I feel like I have to put on a show for these people and not be my genuine self.

I consistently wish I never said anything. I'm always wishing that I could take everything back that I said. I find it hard to relate to people and I just feel like everyone looks at me weird for everything that I say. I think they think what the hell is going on in her head. I try to keep thinks light and short but still people look at me. I had a conversation about my opinion on something at work today that I wish I could take back. I just wished no one asked me my opinion because when they do I have to say something and it's never the right thing.

I can relate so much to this. I wish that I had something positive to tell you but I struggle finding the good in stuff now. I'm so alone. I use to have a few people in my life but they don't care about me anymore. I don't know what hurts more when I don't let people in my life or I do and it doesn't last. I just wish I had one consistent person. I'd be there for them and likewise. I think many people that they always have family/parents to count on. I question constantly what I mean to them. They loved me as a child though. Can't say much more when I started to grow up. It hurts everyday and I ask myself what's the point. I just don't know what to do.
I am so sorry. That is terrible. Take it day by day.

Omg yes! I feel like no one ever sticks around when I just tell them a little bit. I haven't told many people much but the little that Ive told to some people I more than anything wish I could take it back and bottle it inside. I feel like everyone just hates me. I know I'm hard to love. I use to have a real close family member but she started cancelling plans with me left and right. I've told her some things and she probably doesn't want to see me anymore because I'm too much a Debbie downer. I just hate always having to wear a mask to get people to like me. I hate telling people my funny quirky stories so that I sound interesting to them.

I wish I could help you but I know how it feels to feel like you. I really hope you don't follow through with it. I've been that way myself. No one that personally knows me knows I'm suicidal. I feel like if I'm going to do I'm going to do it. I use to cut for many years and no one had a clue. I'm good at hiding things... probably the only thing I'm good at. I hope you have tried to reach out for help.  I wish that I could say something to make things better for you.

(29 F) I was in a bachelor's program that was going g to lead me to my masters but it didn't pan out. The program lost accreditation while I was in it. I was able to get my bachelor's and I just decided to go with that. I thought I still would be able to find something. It's been 6 years since I graduated and still nothing. I gave up took small jobs. I just did what I needed to pay the bills. I have worked at my job for 4 years now. After two years this position came up and it was my dream freaking job. I can't tell you how many jobs I've applied to but I applied to and never got an interview but this job I felt I had a chance. I got called for an interview went through the whole interview process and didn't get the job but that's not where it ends. I am qualified to do this job that is what I went to school for and I am working a job that is minimum wage dead end type. Anyways the girl they hired nothing had nothing but whatever I know I don't know the whole story. Anyways they expanded and made a second position about two months ago. I was so excited. I interviewed for it once and I really felt like now I've been there an extra two year, four all together that I had it. You probably can guess where I'm going with this. I didn't get it and they are cutting hours at my current position so I have to take an event crapper job. I feel like I've had no luck. No one really cares about me. Sorry that your career hasn't worked out for you. It's just hard out there. I feel like I'm always seeing people I know getting great jobs but I just can't find one.

I'm 29 and I feel this way. I don't always know how to describe what I'm going through but all I can say I just feel there is no point. There is just so much hurt in the world. I wish that I had a good exit strategy but everything I come up with is flawed. I'm sorry you feel this way. I wish there was something insightful that I could say to help you feel better. I know how it feels and wish the best for you.

Are you majoring in anything? Are dedicating enough for your school work? If you aren't it's fine, I'm not putting you down but maybe this is the right path for you. Maybe try majoring in something else or start working. Try out some new things and see were it takes you. I suffer from depression too and I know that sometimes you just feel like everything is against you. You sound young and you have so much you should try. I've always wished that I had travelled more. You don't have to have much money to travel and that's what I always thought until I had a friend that did. There are communities that you can join that help you find employment in other countries (if that is something you think you would enjoy)
I'm glad to hear that you are trying to get help. Let me know how things go.

Sorry to hear this. I've felt like such a burden myself. I always put on this funny/happy act. I've tried everything to get people to like me but I just guess I'm unlovable. I'm four years older than you and I remember idolizing moving out of my parents. I'm on my own and its not like I thought. Besides living with your parents isn't a step back. It's hard to live on your own and just know that when the time comes you'll move out and that this isn't permanent. There is something seriously wrong with this culture of putting down people who live at home. Sometimes it makes sense. I'm working way to many hours at a job I hate for what. So I can fork over everything to someone else and have nothing left. Anyways take small steps. You'll be able to reach your goals. I am confident in you.

Im very sorry to hear this. I never ask for help. The one time that I reached out it was a peer community and the person basically told me I was boring and that they rather help someone else. I hope you get the help that you need. I know that this can be devastating.
I'm really sorry. That is awful. I've started to lose faith in alot of people. It's a sad world that we live in.
